headlines.label: Answers with one invented claim that the grounding guard catches

headlines.label: Fully supported answers the guard wrongly blocks
headlines.note: Simulated: scripted answers; the model-in-the-loop run needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.

headlines.label: F1 of the guard as a detector of unsupported answers
False statements made by negating a listed fact that pass the guard
headlines.note: e.g. "It doesn't come in navy." on harbor knit crew (the variant is navy). The guard checks tokens, not polarity.

limitations: Simulated: scripted answers; the model-in-the-loop run needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. No model wrote these answers; real model answers will differ in wording and in which fields they cite.
Answers and phrasings were written by the author of this harness before the guard was run on them; they are not a blind or third-party set.
The guard is a token-level check. It does not judge polarity (negation), and phrasings without a product token ("half price", "tomorrow", "never pills") carry nothing for it to check.
Delivery dates are checked against the store's own estimate with "today" fixed at 2026-11-09.
